about_the_game:
--------Demo release notes--------

This is the demo part of the visual novel "Fool's Ship Beyond the World", by clicking the mouse, reading the text that emerges to advance the plot. The plot is the prologue of the full version, as well as the beginning of the summer firefly chapter and the spirit child chapter, telling a magical story of exploration in a fictional world, you will read the text through mouse clicks to drive the plot, and finally return to reality from the illusion and the adventure with the beautiful girls.

Prologue: A self-proclaimed "narrator" tells you that God will destroy the world in a few days, and it will happen whether you believe it or not.

Say goodbye to the girls you know and continue to enjoy your "life" in the chaos.

Xia Yingzhang: A fate-like fantasy story unfolding by listening to the complaints of "primary school students" who have never known each other by the river.

Ling Youzhang: Encountering a strange girl who talks to herself, under her rhythm, she can't help but fall deeper and deeper - this is where the story begins.

-------- background--------

Liancheng, a city that "lives" on the Xiangjiang River, although it is not a self-motivated place, is definitely very livable. Here we can get up slowly and then go to work and school; You can go to the alley at dessert time to find some sugar and oil baba with 5 pieces of sweet wine in a bowl; You can go to the "Waiting for Death Street" in your leisure time, listen to operas full of Huxiang characteristics or chat with the elderly.......

--------Synopsis--------

A story that takes place between a boy who has lost his parents and a tsundere classmate and a gentle childhood sweetheart.

Have you ever seen a world outside this world?

The world of memory, the world of dreams, the world of imprisonment of "self", the world of freedom and madness.

What is that like?

What is it made of?

If these worlds are doomed to be destroyed -

The disgusting "life" slowly unfolds in the world -

Then since those worlds are experienced by "me" myself.

Which world is real?

Or they are all false 

In any case, let this fool's boat continue to sail far away and sail across the Xiang River! Drive out of the world's borders! Sail to the end of the world!

Be sure to remember: "Survive!" ”

------Game Features------

· Cute character illustrations and CG

· A fairy tale with a beautiful ending

· Three different endings

Character Introduction:

【Xue Lingyou】

"Self-introduction? Of course, I am Shiling's childhood friend and the smartest, cutest, and kindest beautiful girl in this world!"

"And then, let’s continue to live happily together! o(*￣▽￣*)o"

Xue Lingyou is Shiling's childhood friend, living together with Shiling after her parents' passing, supporting each other in life, and filled with hope. She usually calls Xiaoying "Yingbao."Though appearing lively and cheerful on the surface, she harbors strong feelings for Shiling, accompanied by endless loneliness and tenderness towards her.

Height: 168cm

Weight: "A girl's weight is a secret oh✧(≖ ◡ ≖✿)"

Birthday: June 1st.

【Xia Ying】

"I hate self-introductions, I hate all subjective classifications, so don’t bother me, I still have a lot to do, and life must go on—"

"Huh?"

"You said you hope I curse you?"

"Are you a pervert? OxO"

Shiling's otaku friend, a classmate, enjoys being with Shiling and Lingyou, but is unwilling to show it, usually calling Lingyou 'Little Yuzu'.

The proud demeanor on normal days comes from being unaccustomed to and disliking others' concern, having her own thoughts about the world, and having faced many things due to her father’s passing—

Height/Weight: "Are you looking for death? ▄︻┻┳═一……"

Birthday: August 8.

【Shi Ling】

"You say my world is a galgame?"

"Let me tell you! There are neither girls nor love here!"

The male protagonist of this story, a pitiful child who lost his parents in an accident and suffers from amnesia, has forgotten all past *events*, leaving only *experiences*. In this blank world of memory, he can only think, and then he plunges into a cycle of time and a whirlpool of thought—

content_descriptors.notes: All characters in this game are over the age of 18 and may contain content that is not suitable for minors. This game contains violent and gory content.

name: 世界之外的愚人船 Demo
short_description: This is a visual novel, in reality we create different worlds that belong only to you for various reasons, and they will gradually fade away with your memories. Please enjoy this time traveling in different worlds with the girls, and then return to where you are meant to exist - your life.
